# Coverage toolchain alias selection is separate from the compiler version it resolves to

This landing replaces pinned Rust 1.83 toolchain names with stable linux64-rust/win64-rust aliases and removes the pinned reference imports. The comm loader selects upstream tasks by names and resolved aliases; the alias text does not verify its historical compiler artifact. Fixed accepted coverage jobs later select the dev aliases instead. Keep the owned stable-alias phase, later accepted consumers and reported Rust 1.90 default distinct. No taskgraph or compiler build ran.

Scope: Thunderbird coverage build toolchain inputs.
